records.title: Training Facility for Vehicle Technician Training
records.body: Request for information Background: The Canadian Army needs to train members. Traditionally this was done using military facilities, support structures and DND staff. It is no longer possible to keep all training completely in-house. There is a need to approach external training institutions and organizations to help fill this gap. Objectives: This request is issued to understand what is available...

records.title: Leadership Assessment and Coaching Services
records.body: Export Development Canada (EDC) is looking to engage a qualified Supplier to provide the Leadership Assessment and Coaching components of an immersive leadership development program (the Leading with Impact “Immersion Program”). The Immersion Program is designed as an intensive, cohort-based development experience.Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.
